source_title: Pixel Buds Pro 2 get a big $60 Amazon discount
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Google’s Pixel Buds Pro 2 just dropped to $169 on Amazon, which is $60 off the $229 recommended retail price. That’s a 26% discount, and it puts Google’s premium wireless earbuds close to their best pricing yet, so this is a strong time to grab a pair.
This deal covers all colorways, including the latest Olive option. For anyone who’s been waiting for a better price on Google’s top earbuds, this sale stands out because you’re getting a big cut on a fairly new model without giving up any of the headline features.
The Pixel Buds Pro 2 use Google’s Tensor A1 chip and Silent Seal 2.0 active noise cancellation, which Google says can cancel up to twice as much noise as the previous model. They’re also smaller and lighter than before, with a shape designed for a more secure fit. Each earbud is rated IP54 for dust and water resistance, so they’re built to handle workouts, commutes, and daily use.
Battery life is rated at up to eight hours with ANC on or up to 12 hours with ANC off. With the charging case, that stretches to roughly 30 hours with ANC on or 48 hours with ANC off. You also get conversation detection, Find My Device support, improved hearing protection tools, and tight integration with Pixel phones and Google services.
At $169 on Amazon, the Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 are much easier to recommend than at full price. A 26% discount relative to the RRP won’t always be around, so this is a deal worth checking out while it lasts.
